item.title: JERA signs LNG supply agreement with Hokkaido Gas
item.description: JERA Co., Inc. has signed an LNG sale and purchase agreement with Hokkaido Gas Co., Ltd.

item.title: Ukraine-ordered natural gas cargo arrives at Klaipeda LNG terminal
item.description: An LNG cargo from the US ordered by D.TRADING International SA has reached the Klaipeda LNG terminal, operated by KN Energies.

item.title: Stabilis Solutions announces marine bunkering agreement with Carnival Corp.
item.description: Stabilis Solutions, Inc. has entered into a definitive, 10-year offtake agreement with Carnival Corp. & plc to supply LNG in support of Carnival's cruise operations at the Port of Galveston.

item.title: Energy Transfer announces suspension of development of Lake Charles LNG
item.description: Energy Transfer LP is suspending development of the Lake Charles LNG project in order to focus on allocating capital to its significant backlog of natural gas pipeline infrastructure projects.

item.title: Fast-track LNG deployment: From option to necessity
item.description: Morten Christophersen, CEO, ECOnnect, Norway, illustrates the importance of energy flexibility within the current geopolitical climate, and explains how strengthening regional energy security with LNG will be crucial moving forward.

item.title: PTTT partners with Centrica
item.description: PTT International Trading Pte Ltd and Centrica LNG Company Ltd have signed a long-term LNG sale and purchase agreement for a period of 10 years.

item.title: Saipem awarded offshore EPCI contract by QatarEnergy LNG
item.description: Saipem, in partnership with Offshore Oil Engineering Co. Ltd, has been awarded an offshore EPCI contract by QatarEnergy LNG for the COMP5 package of the North Field Production Sustainability Offshore Compression Complexes project.

item.title: Baker Hughes to supply liquefaction equipment for Commonwealth LNG
item.description: Baker Hughes has received a full notice to proceed from Technip Energies on behalf of Commonwealth LNG to supply primary liquefaction equipment for Commonwealth LNG’s 9.5 million tpy export facility.

item.title: GTT receives order from HD KSOE
item.description: GTT has received an order from HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering for the tank design of a new LNG carrier.

item.title: Equinor provides status update for Snøhvit Future project
item.description: Equinor has released updated estimates for progress and costs for the Snøhvit Future project.
